```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
```

```{r}
filepath <- paste0(getwd(), "/data/")
```

# MEPS

```{r}
meps_data <- read_dta(file.path(filepath, "meps_h251.dta"))
```

```{r}
meps_key_variables <- c("POVLEV23", "INSURC23", "TOTSLF23", "PERWT23F")
```

```{r}
meps <- meps_data[, meps_key_variables]
```

```{r}
glimpse(meps)
```
